nodes.label: 120 Hz physics step (physics_dt)
nodes.rationale: 120 Hz equals the PX4 IMU rate; at 60 Hz PX4's rate loop (tuned ~250 Hz) limit-cycles (roll std 6.3 deg vs 0.08 deg at 120 Hz).

nodes.label: B1 no usable failsafe while GPS-denied
nodes.norm_label: b1 no usable failsafe while gps-denied
nodes.rationale: MAVROS sends vision odometry as MAV_FRAME_LOCAL_FRD so EKF2 clears yaw_align and publishes no global position; Land/Hold/RTL navigate to garbage lat/lon (S1).

nodes.label: B11 push_px4_params.py cannot finish on SITL
nodes.norm_label: b11 push_px4_params.py cannot finish on sitl
nodes.rationale: EKF2_HGT_REF and EKF2_MAG_TYPE are reboot_required and SITL denies reboot; sim applies params at boot via px4.params_file.

nodes.label: B13 no automated camera-view obstruction check

nodes.label: B2 HD720 ZED images never reach subscriber
nodes.norm_label: b2 hd720 zed images never reach subscriber
nodes.rationale: Host net.core.rmem_max 212992 overflows on ~9 MB per-frame burst of HD720 left/right/depth over UDP; fix by raising rmem_max to 16 MB.

nodes.label: B3 MAVROS plugins ignore --params-file
nodes.rationale: MAVROS 2.15.1 plugin nodes use use_global_arguments(false); workaround docker/ros/mavros_sim_time.py sets use_sim_time at runtime.

nodes.label: Fixed 2026-09-25: ZED footage blocked/backwards/wrong FOV
nodes.rationale: Three stacked bugs: lens inside Iris nose (x 0.10), quaternion scalar-first vs scipy order, focal length never applied (24 deg HFOV).
